question: What is your cancellation policy?
answer: Our cancellation policies are flexible and vary depending on how far in advance you cancel. Generally, cancellations 60+ days before your tour receive full refunds. Cancellations 30-59 days may incur a 25% fee, while closer cancellations may incur higher fees or be non-refundable. Travel insurance is recommended to protect your investment. We're also happy to discuss specific circumstances and find solutions that work for you.
